What does the verified tick mean?

The Stoatmod team has checked who runs the server and why it stands out. Verification is on top of the normal Discovery review; it does not mean Stoatmod moderates or endorses every message in the server.
How do I get my server verified?

List your server on Discovery first. Once it is approved, open Dashboard → Discovery and choose Apply for verification. Explain which kind of verification fits and add links that prove it, such as your website or social accounts.
